name: win-bash
description: Windows-specific Niubash Bash integration for Codex, including portable install and default config bootstrap.

interface.shortDescription: Run Windows shell commands through Niubash Bash
interface.longDescription: Detects or installs Niubash Bash, activates winuxcmd, writes a default ~/.niubashrc when absent, and injects the resolved shell into Codex exec_command calls.
